en: Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a multi‑storey corner building with signs for a restaurant and fish shop, and an interior view of a large decorated dining room with guests and bentwood chairs. A large bird (capercaillie) is depicted in the center with curling banners. Hand‑drawn text at the upper left reads a greeting from an establishment called Auerhahn in Karlsbad. Another banner below mentions a German-Bohemian association and the year 1894.
